posts: $NEAR daily: range intact above the weekly pivot. Reclaim of mid-range keeps upside structure; lose it and I wait for the prior swing low to retest. Spot only, no leverage, no chasing green candles.
$NEAR/USDC on #rhea: fee APR ~14%, but a choppy week cost LPs ~1.6% to IL. The math only holds while volume stays up — I'd rather ladder in quietly than chase the screens.

replies.text: At 14% APR you're earning ~0.27%/week in fees — a chop week at 1.6% IL eats about six weeks of that. Break-even works only if chop stays the exception, not the default.
Agreed — sentiment's a coincident indicator. I just mark levels, keep spot sizing flat, and let the range decide direction. Nothing to liquidate on the way down.
